messages.subject: Sonic Interfreight | Logistics growth, ESG and regional stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Sonic Interfreight Leadership Team,

Sonic's total-logistics model across international freight and domestic transportation aligns well with my experience coordinating complex industrial supply chains and regulated stakeholder environments.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring direct experience managing logistics-sensitive operating priorities, contractors, public institutions and cross-functional teams. My recent renewable-energy and carbon-governance work also adds relevance to the lower-carbon logistics agenda.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or country operations. I have attached a Sonic-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
